title: Violet phosphorus nanosheets exhibit higher toxicity in the freshwater microalgae Tetradesmus obliquus than black phosphorus nanosheets
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00302D, Paper
Haoxiang Zhang, Fan Zhang, Zhuang Wang, Willie J. G. M. Peijnenburg
Key differences have been identified in the cellular and molecular toxicity mechanisms of freshwater microalgae exposed to violet phosphorus versus black phosphorus nanosheets.
